source_subtopic_title: Acquire, validate, transform, analyse and publish stages
evidence_note: Stage boundaries are taught; verify the full lineage and question/variable catalogue as a practical deliverable.

source_subtopic_title: Idempotence, immutable raw data and deterministic reruns
evidence_note: Idempotence and raw/interim/processed separation are explicit; require a rerun check in the learner exercise.

source_subtopic_title: Dataset manifest, request parameters, checksum and provenance
evidence_note: Manifest fields are shown; verify checksum and exact request are produced in a runnable package.

source_subtopic_title: Relational tables, primary keys, foreign keys and one-to-many relationships
evidence_note: Relational structure and key relationships are taught; verify uniqueness and referential-integrity exercises.

source_subtopic_title: SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY and ORDER BY
evidence_note: SQL joins and grouped summaries are taught; confirm all core clauses are demonstrated and assessed.

source_subtopic_title: Window functions, NULL/date handling, CTEs and subqueries
evidence_note: CTE, ROW_NUMBER and rolling window aggregates are demonstrated; NULL/date edge cases and query-plan tuning remain limited.

source_subtopic_title: Join diagnostics, row-count invariants and indexes/normalisation
evidence_note: Join row-count diagnostics are explicit; index and normalisation instruction is not verified.

source_subtopic_title: HTTP status, timeouts, retries, rate limits and pagination
evidence_note: Timeout, status, bounded retry/backoff and pagination are in the lesson; provider-specific pagination termination remains unverified.

source_subtopic_title: Climate and Earth-observation endpoints; pinned clients and request capture
evidence_note: Provider examples and version pinning are discussed; no live provider call is made in CI.

source_subtopic_title: Local cache, immutable raw downloads and reproducible acquisition
evidence_note: Local cache/raw storage is covered conceptually; cache invalidation and rerun behaviour need a deterministic fixture.

source_subtopic_title: Licence terms, attribution, derived data and redistribution
evidence_note: Licence and attribution checks are taught; exact dataset-specific terms must be verified at acquisition time.

source_subtopic_title: Credentials, environment variables, .env and secret rotation
evidence_note: Secrets outside git and rotation are explicit; verify the exercise never contains real credentials.

source_subtopic_title: Ethical access, personal data and sensitive locations
evidence_note: Ethical access and sensitive-location safeguards are discussed; practical redaction example needs review.

source_subtopic_title: Reproducible acquisition package: script, manifest, README and environment template
evidence_note: Package deliverables are specified; clean-room rerun evidence remains a release gate.

source_subtopic_title: Large-data tools: Arrow/Parquet, Polars, DuckDB, Dask, chunk sizing and memory profiling
evidence_note: Arrow/Parquet, DuckDB, Polars and Dask trade-offs plus a DuckDB/Parquet query are covered; a deterministic chunked-CSV lab checks exact per-station aggregates across chunk sizes and records elapsed time and peak process RSS. Representative real-data benchmarking and broader tool-specific performance comparisons remain gaps.

source_subtopic_title: Reproducibility, validation evidence and scientific limitations
evidence_note: Package acceptance criteria include reproducibility and limitations; execution on a clean environment remains unverified.
